mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP growth signals a weakening economy that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate signals labor market weakness that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals strengthening economic growth that will produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A collapse in housing starts signals a severe demand shock that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals weakening consumer demand that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate coupled with a drop in payroll employment signals severe labor market weakness that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp and PAYEMS declines YoY
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
